newsitem.title: LEBANON: Shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Solidere shares were mixed on increased turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday as A shares rose to $10.25 from a $10.125 record low while B shares held steady at $10.75.
A total of 245,729 Solidere A and B shares changed hands, 32.6 percent up from 185,286 a day earlier.
Bank shares were also mixed with Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce up to $13.375 from $13.25 and Banque Audi shares steady at Monday's $18.375.
Turnover in BLC fell sharply to 1,000 shares from 22,000 and 12,897 Audi shares changed hands against 13,000.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.47 percent to 115.06.
A block of 95,000 Ciments Libanais shares were also traded on the floor at $1.15, unchanged from March 14 when they were last traded.
Total BSE turnover was 345,626 shares for a value of $2,917,123 against 220,286 shares for a value of $2,439,361 on Monday.
There was no trade in the three other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.64 percent to 897.57 and the LISPI rose 0.16 percent to 82.63.
